criteria.assertion: Isolated-process tests for each study/series/instance endpoint with offset=-1, limit=-1, nonnumeric values and extremely large values: no process termination; invalid syntax returns 400.
notes: 33 isolated probes cover study/series/instance routes; the six-resource unit matrix additionally covers scoped routes.

criteria.assertion: Both limit=0 and offset=0 are legal values. With limit=0 (including offset=0), JSON results are [] with HTTP 200; include the required pagination warning when matches remain. offset=0 with a positive or absent limit starts at the first match and does not itself require an empty result.
offset beyond match count returns 200 and []; an in-range limit bounds results correctly; repeat identical queries over unchanged data and compare result order.
Exercise provider APIs directly with negative/extreme inputs and prove no invalid range or addition overflow occurs.
Store two studies for different synthetic patients. /series?PatientID=NO_MATCH returns []; a matching patient returns only that patient’s series.
All Series searches honor StudyInstanceUID, StudyDate, AccessionNumber and ModalitiesInStudy while still combining requested series predicates with AND semantics.
Patient filters on a scoped study-series request cannot return a nonmatching patient. Test both keyword and tag spellings.
Create two patients with CT and MR series. /instances?PatientID=NO_MATCH returns []; /instances?Modality=CT returns only CT instances.
Study Instances honors permitted series filters; All Instances honors study plus series filters together.
Study Series Instances honors patient and instance predicates without leaking instances outside either path UID.
Store instances numbered 1 and 2 plus one missing Instance Number. Query InstanceNumber=2 and 00200013=2; only the second instance matches.
notes: Two numbered instances per patient and one unnumbered MR instance: only Number2 instances match across both studies; no missing-number inheritance.

criteria.assertion: Combine number and SOP UID filters and verify intersections; test supported IS lexical representations according to the declared matching policy.
notes: Declared IS matching normalizes numeric lexical forms: HTTP +2 and stored +002 match integer2.

criteria.assertion: Fixtures differ only by PPS date/time or Scheduled Procedure Step ID/Requested Procedure ID. Each required filter excludes the nonmatching series.
notes: Each predicate is requested alone with positive and negative values; nonmatching and missing PPS/sequence series are excluded. Fixtures also differ in unrelated metadata, which is not queried by these controls.

criteria.assertion: Test 00400275.00400009 and RequestAttributesSequence.ScheduledProcedureStepID, including mixed keyword/tag paths, against equivalent expected results.
Cover multiple sequence items, missing sequences and date/time ranges; verify the same filters on permitted instance resources.
For stored UIDs A/B/C, query A,B and receive exactly A/B at each supported UID level; a single UID remains unchanged.
notes: Three-study A/B/C exclusion is the unit control; independent bridge has two studies, three series and five instances. SOPClass UID list plus single UID control is additionally exercised.

criteria.assertion: Exercise percent-encoded commas through the HTTP query bridge and both keyword/tag names.
A UID list combined with a patient or modality filter returns their intersection, not their union.
Request an available optional attribute absent from default output; confirm it appears with its dictionary tag/VR/value.
notes: PatientAge absent by default and returned as00101010/AS/050Y when explicitly included.

criteria.assertion: Test keyword, hex-tag, nested path, repeated includefield and includefield=all; verify mandatory default fields remain present.

Capture requests for all six QIDO resource forms using the same synthetic options and compare against independent expected keys.
